description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectivityModifyCommandResponse' that extends other interfaces and provides a method to set DittoHeaders. It belongs to the package related to connectivity command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectivityModifyCommandResponse
classes.description: A Java interface representing a response to a connectivity modify command, extending connectivity command response and optional entity capabilities, parameterized with a type that extends itself.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers on the response, returning the response type for chaining.
